WITH money AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS loss_reserve,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END) AS expense_reserve
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" AS ca
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" AS lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_payment" AS ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."expense_reserve" AS er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
cp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Claim_Identifier,
        Policy_Identifier,
        Policy_Number,
        Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier,
        Policy_Holder_Name,
        Agent_Party_Identifier,
        Agent_Name
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_policy"
),
prem AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" AS pa
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."premium" AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    cp.Policy_Holder_Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_id,
    cp.Policy_Holder_Name AS policy_holder_name,
    cp.Agent_Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
    cp.Agent_Name AS agent_name,
    m.loss_payment,
    m.loss_reserve,
    m.expense_payment,
    m.expense_reserve,
    p.premium_amount
FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" AS c
LEFT JOIN money AS m
    ON m.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, c.Claim_Identifier, cp.Policy_Number
LIMIT 500
